# Contributing

This is an unofficial fork of Slic3r. See the [plan](../plan/README.md) for what is
being worked on.

## Bug reports

Please include:

- Slic3r version and `git rev-parse HEAD`
- Operating system and version
- Steps to reproduce, with command line options if used
- For G-code problems: the model file, your exported config, and a preview screenshot
- Expected and actual result

## Patches

- One topic per branch or pull request.
- Add or update tests for behaviour changes.
- Contributions are licensed under AGPL-3.0.
- Ported code: state the source repository, commit and license.
- AI-assisted contributions are welcome; say so, and test them yourself.
